adjacent_support_corollary_boundary.additional_premise: At least one current C041 support cell has encoded length 2*(k+1).
adjacent_support_corollary_boundary.non_effect: This does not construct or prove an element of H_k intersection P_(k+1).
adjacent_support_corollary_boundary.proposed_local_effect: The current prefix exposes MAGIC[0..7], while the parent semantic language has no universally unequal coordinate among h[0..7].

definitions.payload_index_interval: [H,R-1] using zero-based inclusive bit indices before optional padding
definitions.semantic_language: H_k={1||c: there exists r such that x=r||c is an exact length-2k canonical C041 encoding of an UNSAT 3CNF}
definitions.window: h[j]=x[k+j-1] for 1<=j<=7, so the parent window is x[k..k+6]

exact_quantified_candidate.anchor_structure: the clauses touched by x[k..k+6] are left available for the coordinate witness, while two untouched clauses are reserved as opposite repeated-unit clauses on one legal variable
exact_quantified_candidate.cell_quantifiers: For every positive integer tuple (k,a,b,m) satisfying b=bit_length(m), a>=2, m>=4, R=H+3*m*(1+a), p=R mod 2, and R+p=2*k
exact_quantified_candidate.coordinate_corollary: h[0]=1=MAGIC[0], and both marginal values are proposed for every h[j], 1<=j<=7; therefore no coordinate j in {0,...,7} is universally forced unequal to MAGIC[j] over H_k
exact_quantified_candidate.existential_conclusion: there exists an exact canonical UNSAT length-2k parent word x, with h=1||x[k:], such that h[j]=epsilon
exact_quantified_candidate.marginal_quantifiers: for every j in {1,...,7} and every epsilon in {0,1}
exact_quantified_candidate.window_premise: H<=k and k+6<R, equivalently x[k..k+6] lies wholly in the unpadded literal payload

marginal_not_independent_caveat.asserted_meaning: For each fixed (v,j,epsilon), a possibly different H_k member may witness h[j]=epsilon.
not_asserted: one common formula realizes arbitrary prescribed values at all seven coordinates
two witnesses can be chosen to differ only at coordinate j
other bits of the same variable-index token remain fixed while one index bit flips
marginal_not_independent_caveat.reason_for_boundary: Legal variable indices form {1,...,v}, not an unconstrained Boolean a-cube; coordinate-wise marginal support is the exact quantifier needed for the local forced-coordinate corollary.

non_guarantees: no proof or mathematical result in this freeze
no H_k intersection P_(k+1) witness or impossibility result
no classifier, kernel, adapter, falsifier, or evaluator implementation
no hidden label, theorem novelty, independent review, circuit lower bound, or P-versus-NP authority
object: The exact C041 canonical UNSAT suffix language H_k when h[1..7] is wholly inside the literal payload and at least two clauses can be reserved outside the clauses touched by that window.
qoi: Whether an off-window contradictory clause pair certifies coordinate-wise marginal variation inside H_k and thereby removes only the local h[0..7] forced-MAGIC obstruction.

smallest_planned_public_regression.selection_rule: least k among cells satisfying every lemma premise and having nonempty adjacent current support

touched_clause_bound_candidate.claim: The seven consecutive payload bits touch at most two clauses because each clause occupies 3*(1+a)>=9 consecutive payload bits.
touched_clause_bound_candidate.reserve_consequence: Since m>=4, at least two clauses remain untouched and are available for the opposite repeated-unit UNSAT anchor.
